headline: Planning for Autistic Month, Deaf Awareness Month payments, and Disability Awareness Month attendance on 10/22/26.
summary: The commission will plan Autistic Month activities, discuss payments for Deaf Awareness Month, decide who will attend Disability Awareness Month at The Center on 10/22/26, and discuss toy ideas for disabled children in hospital or clinical settings. The ADA Coordinator will give a report, and the next meeting date will be set.
items: Begin to plan Autistic Month, decide date, ask for speakers, make a program, ask City Council to approve budget, etc.
Decide who will attend Disability Awareness Month @ The Center on 10/22/26
Ideas for toys for disabled children in hospital or clinical setting
Set date and time for next meeting: November 5, 2026 @ 5pm
location: Lawrence City Hall, 200 Common Street, 2nd floor
